changelog.1.1.0: Added narrationModes axis, section_header scene family, repeat-group notation + feature-parade variant of demo_90s; G9 generalized to narration_desync; G5 extended with orphan-header rule; 3 new antiPatterns.
changelog.1.2.0: Grounding release: 6 narration modes; 15-archetype visual library; legibility formula rebuilt on subtitle reading-speed research; audio constants re-specified from ITU/EBU/W3C/platform standards; sync tiers; FTC legal floor; Sources appendix (Section 12) maps every constant.

sceneFamilies.purpose: Earn the next ten seconds via tension or spectacle
Make the status-quo cost felt, concretely
Name the product as the answer in one sentence; the turn
Show the end-to-end job: input -> process -> outcome
The it-is-real beat; credibility via unedited-feeling real product
Make the switch from the old way feel obvious
Borrowed trust from real customers and quotes
Brand stamp; the last pixel kept
Chapter title naming the capability the next scene proves; not a hook, promise, or claim

antiPatterns.description: Template with brand colors poured in; no structure-specific decisions
Gears, handshakes, rockets, timelapses standing in for the product
Word-karaoke captions over animated gradients as the whole video
Invented UI wearing real-product costume
Constant-energy feature enumeration with no story turn
Everything drifting, nothing meaning; parallax and whoosh on all elements
Opening on the logo before earning attention
Invented customers, quotes, counts, or badges
Certifications or security badges without verbatim source
Dishonest before-state built to be knocked down
Layout, wording, palette, or asset mimicry of the reference video
Accent color in every scene until it means nothing
VO reading a quote while the viewer reads it; screen and voice disagreeing on numbers or CTA
Cutting away from evidence before it can be read; no proof holds
Missing inputs papered over with invented defaults instead of logged degradations
Section header whose named capability is not proven by the immediately following scene — an unproven capability claim
Verb-claims, numbers, or superlatives smuggled into a section header to dodge Ledger audit
text_driven cards drifting off the music beat grid; slideshow-over-playlist feel
Opening on a logo/brand animation before value; platform data shows steepest audience loss in the opening seconds
Testimonial states an atypical result without a clear generally-expected-performance disclosure; results-may-vary language is insufficient (FTC)
Elements moving on linear ramps; motion reads mechanical instead of physical

map.legibility_gate: PRAC/RES subtitle reading speed: 17cps standard, 20cps Netflix adult ceiling, 12-15 relaxed; six-second rule; derived 0.36s/word
map.word_budget: PRAC VO pacing: conversational 120-150 (NCVS), commercial 150-180, explainer 140-160
map.sync_tiers: STD ITU-R BT.1359-1 (+45/-125 detect, +90/-185 accept); EBU R37 (-60/+40); film ±22ms; PRAC beat-cut on-or-early
map.cut_priority: PRAC Murch, In the Blink of an Eye, Rule of Six
map.music_bed: STD W3C >=20dB below speech; PRAC 15-20dB consensus; BBC drop-4dB
map.ducking: PRAC sidechain practice 6-12dB GR, 100-150ms attack, 300-500ms release
map.loudness: DATA YouTube/Spotify normalize ~-14 LUFS downward-only; -1 dBTP convention; broadcast EBU R128 -23 / ATSC A/85 -24 excluded
map.tempo_bands: RES Dube et al. 40-76/77-107/108-208; arousal rises with tempo; PRAC genre practice
map.attention: DATA Wistia: ~30% lost by 30s; hook ~5s; sub-minute ~52% engagement; flat 1-5min then drop; CTA end-placed best <5min
map.captions_on: DATA/PRAC muted-viewing prevalence; caption engagement/recall lifts
map.micro_motion: PRAC Material Design: ~300ms mobile typical, 375 complex, >400 sluggish, 150-200 small; exits faster; scaled 1.5-2.5x for video
map.evidence_legal: STD FTC substantiation doctrine; 16 CFR 255 (2023, AI endorsers, typicality); consumer-review rule 2024
map.archetypes: PRAC industry explainer-style taxonomies collapsed to 15 scene-level archetypes
map.narration_modes: PRAC/DATA observed shipping registers incl. founder/UGC rise, music-driven text register
map.design_decisions_unsourced: energy curve values, scene-count ceilings, 40% rig cap, 60% cut share, group ceilings — internally consistent taste validated on benchmark teardowns; taste may bias these, never the sourced floors
